Privacy Policy & Data Rights

How WashFlow collects, uses, and protects your personal data in accordance with statutory Kenyan data protection principles.

1. Information We Collect

To fulfill doorstep laundry orders and provide real-time dispatch updates, WashFlow collects minimal necessary personal details:

  • Contact Information: Your phone number is collected to dispatch WhatsApp one-time passwords (OTP), automated order tracking links, and rider arrival notifications.
  • Location Data: Delivery addresses and apartment details provided during booking to navigate courier pickups and drop-offs.
  • Credentials: Usernames and passwords. Passwords are never stored in plaintext and are hashed using Argon2id.

2. How Your Data is Used

Your personal information is used exclusively for operating our laundry service: scheduling couriers, processing M-Pesa payments, and sending order notifications. We do not sell, rent, or trade customer data to advertising networks or third-party marketers.

3. Essential Cookies & Security

WashFlow uses strictly necessary first-party session cookies (wf_session or __Host-wf_session) configured with httpOnly, SameSite, and Secure flags. We do not deploy third-party cross-site behavioral tracking scripts.

4. Your Statutory Data Rights (Kenya DPA 2019)

Under Section 26 of the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019, you have the right to be informed of how your data is used, access your personal data, request correction of inaccurate records, and request deletion of your account. You can manage saved addresses and account settings anytime in your client dashboard, or by contacting our team at support@washflow.co.ke.

Need to exercise your data rights?

Contact our data protection team or manage settings in your client portal.
